name: Cirrus SR22 side yoke
view: the pilot's side yoke from the seat, looking left at the side panel: the shaft slides in and out of the panel (pitch) and turns (roll), the handle's thumb top carries the four-way trim hat and the autopilot disconnect button, the push-to-talk sits on the front of the handle
origin: JoyPro's own vector drawing: the side yoke's outline and the switch layout reconstructed from the public Cirrus SR22 descriptions (Cirrus Perspective pilot guide overview, the MSFS and X-Plane SR22 documentation, Wikipedia) and public photos looked at for proportions; the exact positions of the buttons on the handle are not confirmed. Not traced from a photo.
